faqs.question: Who is Mikołaj Piech?
faqs.answer: Mikołaj Piech is the founder of Clevr Apps and a developer from Poland who designs, builds, and ships web apps, mobile apps, websites, and consumer software from idea and product design through development and launch.

faqs.question: How are Mikołaj Piech and Clevr Apps connected?
faqs.answer: Clevr Apps is the independent product studio founded and run by Mikołaj Piech. It publishes his consumer apps for iOS, Android, and the web, including Trailo, Subby, Doso, Solvee, and Twoja Sieć.

faqs.question: What apps has Mikołaj Piech built?
faqs.answer: Mikołaj Piech has built Charmy Books (personalized children's books), co-built Safe Labs with Oskar Minor and Kamil Zdebski (website for cybersecurity workshops), and created Trailo (AI travel planning), Subby (subscription manager), Doso (personal health app), and Solvee (AI homework helper, which he sold after 25K+ downloads). His products have reached more than 30K downloads overall and shipped on the web, App Store, and Google Play.

faqs.question: Who created Charmy Books?
faqs.answer: Charmy Books, a web app for creating personalized children's books, was created by Mikołaj Piech. It turns a child's look, interests, family, and life into a custom illustrated story.

faqs.question: Who built the Safe Labs website?
faqs.answer: The Safe Labs website was designed and developed by Mikołaj Piech, Oskar Minor, and Kamil Zdebski for cybersecurity workshops they co-organized for 12–14-year-old primary school students. The workshops covered phishing, cyberbullying, password and privacy protection, and verifying information online.

faqs.question: Who created Subby?
faqs.answer: Subby, a subscription manager app for iOS and Android, was created by Mikołaj Piech. It helps users track trials and subscriptions to avoid unwanted charges.

faqs.question: Who created Solvee?
faqs.answer: Solvee, an AI homework helper app for iOS and Android, was created by Mikołaj Piech. It reached 25K+ downloads before being acquired in February 2026.

faqs.question: Who created Doso?
faqs.answer: Doso, a personal health app for iOS, was created by Mikołaj Piech. It helps users manage medications, lab results, and symptoms with AI-powered insights.

faqs.question: Who created Trailo?
faqs.answer: Trailo, an AI travel planning product for web, iOS, and Android, was created by Mikołaj Piech. It covers flights, hotels, tickets, and hour-by-hour itineraries.

faqs.question: Does Mikołaj Piech build products for clients?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mikołaj Piech works with founders and businesses to design and develop web apps, mobile apps, product websites, landing pages, and other digital products from idea to launch.

faqs.question: How can I contact Mikołaj Piech?
faqs.answer: Email hello@mikolajpiech.com, or find him on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/mikolajpiech), X (@mikolajpiech), GitHub (github.com/realmikolajpiech), or Instagram (@mikolajpiech).
